title: Diagnosing and Repairing Citation Failures in Generative Engine Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2603.09296v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) aims to improve content visibility in AI-generated responses. However, existing methods measure contribution (how much a document influences a response) rather than citation, the mechanism that actually drives traffic back to creators. Also, these methods apply generic rewriting rules uniformly, failing to diagnose why individual documents are not cited. This paper introduces a diagnostic approach to GEO that asks why a document fails to be cited and intervenes accordingly. We develop a unified framework comprising: (1) the first taxonomy of citation failure modes spanning different stages of a citation pipeline; (2) AgentGEO, an agentic system that diagnoses failures using this taxonomy, selects targeted repairs from a corresponding tool library, and iterates until citation is achieved; and (3) a document-centric benchmark evaluating whether optimizations generalize across held-out queries.

translated_title: 生成式引擎优化中引用失败的诊断与修复
translated_abstract: 生成式引擎优化旨在提升内容在AI生成回答中的可见性。然而，现有方法衡量的是贡献度（即文档对回答的影响程度），而非引用——真正将流量引回内容创作者的机制。此外，这些方法统一套用通用的改写规则，无法诊断出单个文档为何未被引用。本文提出了一种面向GEO的诊断方法，探究文档为何未能被引用并进行针对性干预。我们构建了一个统一框架，包括：（1）首个覆盖引用流程不同阶段的引用失败模式分类体系；（2）AgentGEO——一个智能体系统，利用该分类体系诊断失败原因，从相应的工具库中选择针对性修复方案，并迭代优化直至成功获得引用；（3）一个以文档为中心的基准测试，用于评估优化效果能否泛化到未见过的查询。
tldr: 本文提出首个引用失败模式分类体系与智能体系统AgentGEO，通过诊断文档未被AI生成回答引用的具体原因并施加针对性修复，显著提升生成式引擎优化中的引用效果。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the first taxonomy of citation failure modes and an agentic system, AgentGEO, that diagnoses why documents fail to be cited in AI-generated responses and applies targeted, iterative repairs to achieve citations.
